Context Definition

event_type == 'off_ball_run'

Available Metrics

count_off_ball_runs Count
Count all off-ball runs
Example: 68 runs
count_targeted_off_ball_runs Count
Count off-ball runs where player was targeted with a pass
Example: 26 targeted runs
count_received_off_ball_runs Count
Count off-ball runs where player successfully received a pass
Example: 18 received runs
xthreat_off_ball_runs Threat
Sum of xthreat values for all runs
Example: 0.87
xthreat_targeted_off_ball_runs Threat
Sum of xthreat values where targeted == True
Example: 0.42
xthreat_received_off_ball_runs Threat
Sum of xthreat values where targeted == True and received == True
Example: 0.31
xpass_completion_off_ball_runs Probability
Sum of xpass_completion values for all runs
Example: 12.5
xpass_completion_targeted_off_ball_runs Probability
Sum of xpass_completion where targeted == True
Example: 8.2
xpass_completion_received_off_ball_runs Probability
Sum of xpass_completion where targeted == True and received == True
Example: 7.1
count_dangerous_off_ball_runs Count
Count events where dangerous == True
Example: 15 dangerous runs
count_dangerous_targeted_off_ball_runs Count
Count events where targeted == True and dangerous == True
Example: 8 dangerous targeted runs
count_dangerous_received_off_ball_runs Count
Count events where targeted == True, received == True, and dangerous == True
Example: 6 dangerous received runs
count_difficult_off_ball_runs Count
Count events where difficult_pass_target == True
Example: 24 difficult runs
count_difficult_targeted_off_ball_runs Count
Count events where targeted == True and difficult_pass_target == True
Example: 9 difficult targeted runs
count_difficult_received_off_ball_runs Count
Count events where targeted == True, received == True, and difficult_pass_target == True
Example: 5 difficult received runs
avg_speed_avg_off_ball_runs Physical
Average of speed_avg values for all runs
Example: 22.4 km/h
count_hsr_off_ball_runs Physical
Count events where speed_avg_band == 'hsr'
Example: 35 high-speed runs
count_sprint_off_ball_runs Physical
Count events where speed_avg_band == 'sprinting'
Example: 12 sprint runs
avg_distance_covered_off_ball_runs Physical
Average of distance_covered values for all runs
Example: 15.3 meters
